title: Thrilling Wildlife Encounters at Yala National Park
description: Get up close with leopards, elephants, and exotic birds in Sri Lanka's most famous wildlife sanctuary.
author: Tourvir Team
content: If you are a nature lover, Yala National Park is an absolute dream. Located on the southeastern coast, Yala boasts one of the highest leopard densities in the world. A jeep safari at dawn offers the best chance to spot these majestic cats, along with herds of elephants, sloth bears, and crocodiles. The park's stunning combination of dry woodland and coastline makes for an unforgettable safari experience.
